disposition_mapping.rationale: Due-item selection is absorbed into an automated selection-and-proposal step; the ERP identifies due approved matched invoices as the first phase of proposal generation, preserving consumption of approved matched invoices (PRE-R-01).
Proposal generation survives (PRE-R-08) as the automated grouping logic within TGT-01, run by the ERP under AP analyst configuration, distinct in actor from the approval step to satisfy PRE-R-04.

Proposal review survives (PRE-R-09) but is restructured so automated controls flag duplicates, blocked vendors and bank-detail changes, leaving the AP supervisor to adjudicate exceptions. Ordering before approval (PRE-R-02) and before file release (PRE-R-03) is preserved.
Payment approval survives unchanged in substance (PRE-R-10), performed by an authorised signatory distinct from the proposal-generation actor (PRE-R-04), and still precedes file release (PRE-R-05).
Payment file generation and release survives (PRE-R-11), occurring only after approval and review are complete, satisfying PRE-R-02, PRE-R-03 and PRE-R-05.

Bank confirmation receipt is unconstrained by design; it is redesigned as an automated API-based matching process, still producing the bank settlement confirmation consumed downstream by posting (feeds PRE-R-06).

Posting and clearing persists with automation added, but continues to consume the bank settlement confirmation (PRE-R-06) and the settlement-date exchange rate (PRE-R-07) to recognise FX settlement differences per IAS 21 (KB-08) and maintain determinable payables derecognition per IFRS 9 (KB-11).

Remittance advice is unconstrained by design; it is redesigned as an automated electronic dispatch triggered by settlement posting, retaining the vendor notification function with reduced manual effort.

steps.description: The ERP automatically identifies approved, matched invoices due under their payment terms (including foreign-currency items) and generates a payment proposal grouped by vendor, currency and payment method. The AP analyst configures selection parameters and reviews the system-generated output before it moves to review.
steps.name: Automated due-item selection and payment proposal generation

steps.description: The system automatically flags duplicate payments, blocked vendors and recent vendor bank-detail changes against the payment proposal; the AP supervisor adjudicates flagged exceptions and removes or holds items, producing a reviewed proposal. This step must complete before approval and before file release to the bank.
steps.name: Risk-based proposal review

steps.description: The reviewed proposal is approved for payment by an authorised signatory acting within delegated limits, distinct from the actor who generated the proposal, before any payment file is released.
steps.name: Payment approval

steps.description: The approved proposal, once review and approval are complete, is converted into a bank payment file and released to the bank by treasury.
steps.name: Payment file generation and release to bank

steps.description: A bank API feed automatically returns execution confirmations, which the system matches line-by-line to the transmitted payment file; treasury monitors exceptions rather than performing manual reconciliation.
steps.name: Automated bank settlement confirmation and matching

steps.description: Settled payments are posted automatically, clearing open items in the AP subledger and recording cash in the GL, with foreign-currency settlement differences recognised using the settlement-date exchange rate; the GL accountant reviews system-generated postings and handles exceptions.
steps.name: Posting and clearing

steps.description: Remittance advice detailing the invoices settled by each payment is generated and electronically dispatched to vendors automatically upon posting confirmation, with the AP analyst handling delivery exceptions.
steps.name: Automated remittance advice dispatch
